messages:
Priya (People Ops): heads-up — we pushed a small but important update to the Time Off & PTO section of the handbook: https://handbook.redwood.ai/policies/time-off (TL;DR below)
Priya (People Ops): main changes: auto-routing for approvals (manager -> backup approver), clarified carryover caps, and a 10-min microlearning module on the new flow that will be required for managers + people who approve time off.
Liam (HR Manager): quick q — for requests already pending in the queue, will they get re-routed automatically to the new backup approver?
Priya (People Ops): yes, pending requests will be re-evaluated by the system and routed to the designated backup. Ops will manually intervene for anything stuck >48h. If you spot a stuck request run:```hrctl list-requests --status pending --age >48h``` and ping me.
Sofia (Eng Manager): are contractors included in carryover changes? we have a couple of 1099s with recurring PTO requests.
Priya (People Ops): contractors are not eligible for carryover — added a short section in the handbook. Contractors still request time off via the same tool but approvals go to their assigned org lead. I linked the contractor note in the doc.
ben.dev: will this change update OOO calendar entries automatically? trying to avoid manual double-entry for my team.
Priya (People Ops): good call — calendar sync is enabled but requires manager opt-in per team. If you want it turned on for eng/infra, reply here with your team name and I'll enable it. :point_down:
hr-bot: Training assigned: "PTO policy update — Approver microlearning" to users: managers+approvers. Due: 2 weeks from assignment. Link: https://lms.redwood.ai/course/pto-approver
Priya (People Ops): tracking: managers please confirm backup approver for your team in this shared sheet by EOD Friday: https://sheets.redwood.ai/pto-backups - one row per team (team name, primary approver, backup approver, calendar-sync: yes/no). Reply here with "ACK" when done.
Sofia (Eng Manager): ACK — added eng-infra row, backup is @marta.ops
Liam (HR Manager): noted. I'll coordinate exceptions and run weekly stuck-request checks until the system stabilizes.
Priya (People Ops): thanks all — will post a short summary and an internal FAQ in #docs once we collect confirmations. :white_check_mark:
ben.dev: thanks! will opt-in calendar for eng-frontend.
hr-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Complete PTO approver microlearning" will ping uncompleted users 3 days before due date.
